instruction: Transform the receipt image at /home/user/OIP.jpg to grayscale and save it as 'receipt_bw.png' on the Desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task requires converting the color receipt image to grayscale and saving to Desktop. Evaluator checks if the output file exists and is in grayscale mode by analyzing the image mode and verifying that all RGB channels have equal values.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts image color mode from the specified VM path (/home/user/Desktop/receipt_bw.png)
Getter uses robust grayscale detection: checks both PIL mode L and verifies RGB channels are equal using numpy
Metric correctly handles expected parameter when type=rule (directly accesses expected.get("is_grayscale"))
Metric properly checks file existence before validation (returns 0.0 if file does not exist)
Complete coverage: verifies both grayscale conversion (is_grayscale=true) and correct save location (Desktop/receipt_bw.png)
Expected value is semantically correct: is_grayscale=true matches the instruction requirement
Data flow is correct: Getter extracts grayscale status → Metric compares boolean values → Returns 1.0 on match
